mapNote: Study-region reference points: the original 52 locations use supplied forcing-region centroids, not dam outlets or gage positions. Wolf Creek and Dale Hollow use USGS lake-station reference coordinates. Geography is a study overview, not a flow-routing network.
quantityNote: Estimated Local Flow (ELF) is a flow quantity, not a site type. Legacy model identifiers remain internal matching keys. Reservoirs and gages require their own quantity definitions, model mapping and input coverage checks.
coverageNote: The study selection does not establish that model inputs or a runnable skill exist for every location. Wolf Creek and Dale Hollow have no supplied model-site mapping.
